title: Some public/operator requirements (FAQ, status page, accommodation form and certificates) are not fully delivered

original_titles.title: Accommodation request field not reachable from the participant profile

problem: A dedicated FAQ/status page, accommodation request form, published rules PDF and some event support content are not present or not demonstrably complete. These are user-support and event operations requirements whose priority depends on the approved event checklist.
impact: Participants may not know supported devices, outage procedure, accessibility accommodations or service incidents; coordinators may handle requests in ad hoc channels.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Have the event owner identify which support pages/forms are mandatory before public launch.
Publish FAQ topics for supported browsers/devices, account access, offline/network drop, uploads, deadlines, appeals and contact escalation.
Add an accommodation request path with restricted access, minimal data collection and a documented review SLA.
Publish a public status/incident page or identify a third-party page; do not claim availability monitoring exists until it is configured.
Generate rules PDF from the same versioned content that the platform stores and participants accept.

acceptance_criteria: Every required participant support item has an owner, URL, response process and retention policy.
Rules PDF and web rules share the same version/hash.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
